title: Government Stablecoin Acceptance Audit
description: Assesses a government acceptor's aggregate stablecoin receipt ledger against its written acceptance policy — eligible tokens, conversion window, unconverted holding cap, refund rule and custody — and reconciles tokens received, converted and credited in fiat line by line, reporting policy conformance, reconciliation breaks, peak unconverted exposure and an overall verdict. Aggregate per-day-per-token totals in integer minor units only; no payer data is accepted. Every policy parameter is caller-declared.

profile.description: Policy profile. Only "generic" ships; every policy parameter is caller-declared.

policy.description: The written acceptance policy being audited against. Caller-declared.

eligible_tokens.description: Eligible tokens: [{token_code, issuer_regime, reserve_attestation_ref?}]. Required, non-empty.

conversion_window_hours.description: Maximum hours from receipt to conversion. Required, non-negative.

max_unconverted_value.description: Maximum unconverted carrying value in minor units. Required, non-negative.

fiat_tolerance_value.description: Fiat-credit tolerance in minor units. Optional, default 0.

receipts.description: Aggregate receipt rows, one per token per day, in non-decreasing day order per token: {token_code, day?, received_value, converted_value, fiat_credited_value, refunds_value, max_hours_to_conversion, conversion_rate_variance_bp}. Minor units.

mcp_tool_definition.name: assess_government_stablecoin_acceptance
mcp_tool_definition.description: Assesses a government acceptor's aggregate stablecoin receipt ledger against its written acceptance policy and reconciles tokens received, converted and credited in fiat, with exposure while held. Aggregate-only inputs; no payer data.

input_schema_provenance: Each property is exactly the policy_parameters member the kernel reads; there is no other input surface.
author: PostOakLabs
